Amy (sales): Heads-up — BrightBank wants numbers for a 3‑week POC. They expect ~250 rps with 99th pct latency target <800ms. Need recommended reserved GPU config for a commit quote, autoscale policy suggestions, and answers for security questionnaire. @Diego can you map this to node counts?
Diego (eng): Do we have the traffic shape? 250 rps sustained or short bursts? Avg tokens per request?
Amy (sales): Customer says avg ~220 tokens, peaks ~420 tokens, ~30% multi‑turn chat. Sustained ~180 rps with spikes to 250 for 10–20m windows. Concurrency ~1k users during peak.
Maya (solutions): For that profile I'd lean toward 2x 80GB class reserved nodes (or 3x 40GB if they need lower mem). With quantized model and KV cache warm we should hit ~220–260 rps. Batching config matters.
Diego (eng): Rough calc from our perf table: an optimized 80GB host does ~120 rps at 220 tokens. Two hosts ≈240 rps assuming warm KV and continuous batching. Plan autoscale to add spot-backed nodes for spikes.
Sam (infra): Proposed autoscale policy: baseline = 2 reserved nodes, scale +1 when queue depth > 75% (5s avg), cooldown 180s, max = 4 nodes. Prewarm hook: run `prewarm --model v2-quant --kv-warm=1` 5m before expected ramp.
Priya (security): Security questionnaire flags: they require CMK (customer-managed KMS), SOC2 copy, data residency proof, and optional VPC peering. We support CMK and SOC2, peering needs legal/network signoff. I'll start the questionnaire.
Amy (sales): Pricing question from BrightBank: what's the delta if they reserve 2 nodes monthly vs pay-as-you-go with burst credits? They want a simple example.
Maya (solutions): Suggested commercial offer: 12mo commit for reserved nodes = compute price * 0.80 (20% off), burst credits for extra nodes at +30% over reserved rate. Example calc included in proposal doc.
Diego (eng): Operational caveat: latency SLO depends heavily on KV cache heat and batching. If many unique prefixes, effective throughput drops; recommend warmup script and a canary load test. Also note model quantization changes perf/quality tradeoffs.
Amy (sales): Blockers to close deal: (1) VPC peering legal signoff, (2) confirm CMK cross-account key policy, (3) performance smoke test results to validate numbers.
Sam (infra): I'll author the autoscale config snippet and prewarm playbook. Example snippet: ```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline: 2
  max: 4
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75
  cooldown_s: 180
prewarm:
  command: prewarm --model v2-quant --timeout 300
```
Amy (sales): Action items: @Diego run perf smoke test and post numbers (ETA: EOD), @Maya draft price tiers & example calc, @Priya start sec questionnaire, @Sam publish autoscale + prewarm snippets. Sync 10:30 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Diego (eng): Ack — starting load test now, will post results in this thread once complete.
